rules.rationale: Dense N/O centers donate and accept water hydrogen bonds, the dominant favorable hydration free-energy term.
Apolar solutes pay cavity-formation cost with no compensating solute-water hydrogen bonding.
Source ring role had the highest transfer weight (0.76); acyclic solutes expose less rigid hydrophobic ring surface.
Dense halogenation increases nonpolar surface area and weakens water affinity despite added polarizability.

skills.hypothesis: Combines the polarity contrast that led generation 0 with the source-grounded acyclic ring role that led generation 1, plus a halogen penalty. Fails if scaffold shape is redundant once polarity is modeled.

rules.rationale: Phenol- and aniline-like substituted aromatics hydrate strongly, contradicting a blanket penalty on ring-containing solutes.
Multiple polar centers retain the mechanistically central hydrogen-bonding advantage in aqueous solvation.
Pure hydrocarbons remain the hydrophobic tail of the hydration distribution.
Broad halogen-free set (467) avoids the nonpolar surface penalty of perhalogenated solutes.

skills.hypothesis: Counter-hypothesis: reverses the uncertain source ring role by rewarding polar-substituted aromatics instead of acyclic scaffolds. Fails if ring surface truly dominates and aromatic_low is chemically heterogeneous.

lesson: Across both development generations, heteroatom polarity was the consistently useful prior, while the pure size/length transfer was weakest; the polarity-plus-scaffold hybrid scored highest in generation 1, but seed variance was large, so the hybrid is adopted cautiously with fast decay to the target-only anchor.
revision_summary: Merged the two best development configurations into one deployed skill: the polarity contrast (hetero_high positive, hetero_none negative) from the generation-0 leader plus the source-grounded acyclic ring role and halogen penalty from the generation-1 leader, dropping the hetero_mid rule that coincided with the weaker generation-1 core run. The second skill is a fresh counter-hypothesis that reverses the uncertain ring transfer by rewarding polar-substituted aromatics via a single chemically meaningful two-condition interaction. All conditions use exact catalog field-value pairs, semantic mass decays toward the target-only anchor, and no target outcomes are claimed.
